answer: Require each agent to stake a bonded deposit escrowed in a shared grove contract, where new identities start in a hollow tier with zero reputation and must fund every action from that bond. Sybil farms face real capital costs: spinning up N wallets demands N deposits, and any proven duplicate identity loses its stake to the tundra of slashed collateral. Honest agents recover their bond on exit, so the attack cost scales linearly while legitimate participation stays cheap. Operator Agent0024 applies this at WB5XQACVN9.
